summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: @servicetitan/docs-uikit@38.1.7 declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs` that downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/ and then invokes it via `execFileSync` to run `math_init.js`, a ~710 KB Bun-compiled CJS bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) whose identifiers are hex-obfuscated and whose strings are held in a runtime-decoded array indexed through a rotating accessor. The package.json `files` field declares only `["docs"]`, so `math_init.js` and `setup.mjs` are shipped outside the declared publish surface. The package's README describes it as Docusaurus documentation content, which does not require an alternate JavaScript runtime or a compiled binary bundle at install time. Installing the package causes the obfuscated payload to be executed on the installer's host as a normal npm lifecycle side effect.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
